priorityList: Cast Remorseless Winter on cooldown if the Gathering Storm talent is active.
Cast Pillar of Frost on cooldown, ensuring you have Runic Power pooled if using Breath of Sindragosa.
Activate Breath of Sindragosa while Pillar of Frost is active.
Use Frostwyrm's Fury during Pillar of Frost to trigger Apocalypse Now and Chosen of Frostbrood, or to refresh their buffs.
Use Empower Rune Weapon if you have fewer than 2 Runes or are about to run out of resources during Pillar of Frost.
Use Obliterate if you have 2 stacks of Killing Machine, or 1 stack and at least 3 Runes available.
Use Howling Blast whenever Rime is active.
Cast Frost Strike if the target has 5 stacks of Razorice and you are using the Shattering Blade talent.
Cast Frost Strike if Runic Power is nearly full (deficit less than 30) to avoid overcapping.
Use Obliterate whenever Killing Machine is active.
Cast Frost Strike as your primary Runic Power spender.
Use Obliterate as your primary Rune spender.
Activate offensive trinkets, potions, and racial abilities during Pillar of Frost for maximum burst.
